documents: export agent briefs and agents.md documents for supported coding hosts without granting execution authority.
every adapter remains export-only and declares its supported artifacts through an explicit profile.
build a bounded read-only workspace snapshot for agents while omitting secrets, terminal input, command text, and output bodies.
snapshot generation never creates missing queue state or exposes secret identifiers, encrypted payloads, commands, or output tails.
verify the agent snapshot replaces credential references with presence flags and never serializes their secret identifiers.
execute queue work orders and agent evaluations from the command line under explicit workspace and vault contracts.
failures retain stable error codes and json mode never reports an unsuccessful operation as success.
launch the locked rust workduck cli from the repository while forwarding user arguments and its exit status.
the launcher executes the locked workduck-cli binary from this repository and preserves its process result.
publish closed json schema 2020-12 contracts for workduck entities, queue artifacts, runs, and gates.
published object schemas reject undeclared properties unless a versioned contract explicitly permits them.
assemble the tauri desktop runtime, managed state, plugins, and explicit frontend-to-native command registry.
frontend-accessible native operations are registered explicitly through the tauri invoke handler.
define the shared workduck entity, queue, run, gate, risk, and lifecycle vocabulary used across packages.
runtime guard values and their exported typescript unions describe the same closed vocabulary.
apply an explicit set of cli environment variables through tauri and normalize native validation or write failures.
unavailable or malformed native responses fail closed and never report variables as applied.
resolve git from trusted absolute path entries and run prompt-free bounded child processes with separate inspection and mutation profiles.
git is never resolved from the current directory or a caller-supplied path, and captured output retains only bounded head and tail bytes.
enumerate local developer processes and force-stop a selected instance only after identity revalidation while redacting display commands.
a kill rechecks an identity derived from unsanitized process facts, while user-visible command text remains redacted.
own spawned process trees and terminate their descendants across windows jobs and unix process groups.
dropping an active process owner or shutting down the app cannot intentionally leave its registered descendants running.
create, open, and delete bounded project folders and preview or apply ssealed scaffolds through tauri commands.
repository folder operations are normalized against the selected workspace and surface closed error codes.
enforce native project-folder containment and apply ssealed scaffolds with locking, journaling, recovery, and conflict-safe rollback.
scaffold apply never overwrites conflicts, and recovery or rollback removes only files whose recorded checksums still match.
validate, persist, and read bounded repository-import attempt state and phase records from the native sqlite store.
only closed source-kind, state, and phase values with required repository identity and timestamps are written.
read and persist terminal repository-operation records through tauri and normalize the latest valid record for each repository.
only complete succeeded or failed records with every required identity and timestamp field enter the repository-indexed result.
clone, inspect, initialize, synchronize, fork, and publish project repositories through bounded native git operations.
native and github failures are returned as closed domain error codes rather than successful repository state.
execute bounded native clone, inspection, git mutation, fork, and github publication operations with explicit credential and cache boundaries.
inspections avoid credentials and optional locks, while mutations use bounded processes and return closed repository errors.
invoke bounded repository tasks through tauri and normalize their commands, run records, states, and failures for the ui.
malformed native responses never become successful typed task results.
discover toolchain commands, launch bounded repository tasks in terminals, and persist or reconcile native task-run records.
tasks are selected from a closed vocabulary, repository paths remain inside the workspace, and running records are revalidated against live process identity.
persist workspace project registries through tauri sqlite while migrating and preserving the browser legacy fallback.
a failed sqlite read or write returns an explicit error together with the safest available registry state.
compile deterministic markdown prompt documents and agent briefs from typed sections and workduck entity references.
prompt output preserves the declared section order and ends with one normalized newline.
define, construct, transition, parse, and serialize versioned queue work orders, result reports, proposals, and task evaluations.
constructed and transitioned artifacts retain their versioned schema identity and valid lifecycle states.
preview, estimate, execute, cancel, and inspect queue work-order runs through the native execution boundary.
execution requires an explicit confirmation token and never converts an unknown native response into success.
validate and coordinate native multi-agent queue execution, secret resolution, cancellation, confirmation, and exclusive result-report creation.
execution requires the current estimate token, respects global and provider permits, and never exposes resolved secrets through prompt previews.
create and inspect the workspace queue directory and perform bounded reads, writes, updates, and deletes of queue files.
all queue paths are workspace-relative native results and malformed responses fail with explicit queue folder errors.
enforce native queue directory, path, size, count, exclusive-write, update, delete, and evaluation-delegation constraints.
only known queue child directories and file suffixes are addressable, and create operations never overwrite an existing artifact.
track workspace-scoped queue read markers, unread counts, pruning, and browser change notifications.
unread counts ignore unsupported entries and stale read markers can be pruned against the current file set.
schedule bounded concurrent git inspections, coalesce shared paths, and stream repository-specific results to subscribers.
the queue is capacity-bounded and duplicate subscribers do not create duplicate inspection jobs for the same path.
encrypt and decrypt versioned secret-vault payloads through the native argon2id and xchacha20-poly1305 boundary.
empty credentials, malformed envelopes, and unknown native responses fail without returning plaintext or a valid envelope.
own bounded interactive terminal sessions, process trees, input, output cursors, and lifecycle commands for the desktop runtime.
session output and input stay within byte limits and replacing or stopping a session does not intentionally orphan its process tree.
compile agent run briefs and deterministic local run, shell, gate, and project-inventory summaries from core domain records.
a failed gate check blocks its gate and shell-run records preserve their explicit approval and execution states.
read and atomically update allowlisted workspace data files with registry revision checks, paired commits, and crash recovery.
generic writes cannot bypass registry revisions, paired agent and persona updates commit under one lock, and secrets sync first enforces ignore policy.
validate workspace paths as readable absolute directories and return canonical display paths with closed error codes.
only existing readable absolute directories produce a successful normalized workspace path.
select a workspace directory and normalize closed native validation responses for frontend callers.
validation succeeds only when the native boundary returns a non-empty normalized path; unavailable or malformed responses fail closed.
initialize a workspace repository layout, git, mustflow, managed work-order instructions, and workduck ignore policy through bounded native steps.
managed instructions remain single-copy and any protected agents change refreshes its existing manifest-lock entry.
serialize, encrypt, parse, decrypt, and normalize versioned workspace and project-registry synchronization envelopes.
decrypted data is accepted only when envelope algorithms, versions, and normalized registry payloads match the closed sync contract.
normalize workspace sync-file names and expose closed tauri read and write results to the frontend.
a successful client result requires an explicit normalized native path and, for reads, string content; malformed responses fail closed.
resolve, validate, atomically write, and size-bound reads of a native workspace synchronization file.
the target is a plain file under an existing absolute folder, never a symlink or directory, and reads are capped at five mib.
inspect and serialize native git fetch, pull, commit, and push operations for a workspace sync file with safe remote reporting.
operations for the same folder are serialized, credential-bearing remotes are never displayed, and divergent remote state fails closed.
